name: Fire TV Stick 4K (2018)
notes: Original first-generation 2018 model only, not the newer 4K or 4K Max. Unlock eligibility depends on the hardware revision and installed Fire OS. There is no verified one-click WebUSB install for this model in ROMinit.

modes.adb: Enable ADB debugging in Fire TV Developer Options and follow Amazon’s ADB connection instructions. Stock Fire TV debugging is normally over the local network; this is not an unlocked USB flashing mode.
modes.recovery: Only after a successful supported community unlock: enter the installed TWRP using the unlock package’s recovery instructions. Do not assume stock recovery can install LineageOS.

unlock.text: Community Linux/FireISO USB unlock only, after checking exact hardware and Fire OS eligibility. Amazon provides no ordinary customer bootloader-unlock button or public unlock token.
steps: Check the exact installed Fire OS and hardware revision against the current mantis unlock guide before making changes. A model number alone does not establish eligibility.

Review the maintainer compatibility notes: VM190-and-later revisions have BootROM download mode disabled. An alternate Fire OS 6.2.8.1 route was later patched; this is not a universal firmware cutoff or a promise that downgrade is safe.
Only if eligible, follow the community Linux/FireISO USB procedure. It can require opening the stick and board-level work; unlocking and installing another OS can erase data or brick it.
Tick this final step only after the supported unlock succeeds and TWRP recovery is installed and verified. Otherwise stop here.
hints: Keep the Fire OS version unknown until you have checked it in Settings → My Fire TV → About.
Amazon-signed unlock images are not a public consumer unlock service. Never use a generic fastboot unlock command for this model.
Use the exact mantis guide and files; instructions for tank, sheldon, karat or another Fire TV are not interchangeable.

pivots.problem: The guide does not support this hardware/firmware combination
pivots.fix: Keep the existing OS and stop. Do not erase partitions, guess a downgrade, or try another Fire TV model’s files.

recovery.text: Amazon’s factory-reset instructions erase apps and user data but keep Fire OS; they are not a USB firmware reflash or a guaranteed recovery from overwritten partitions. No public official Amazon USB flasher was found. Modified/unbootable sticks need the exact applicable community recovery guide.
